name: trueroas-api
description: TrueROAS api — the only door to Postgres (AD-11).

scripts.build: esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs --external:pg && node -e "import('node:fs').then(fs => fs.cpSync('src/db/sql', 'dist/sql', { recursive: true }))"
